StarterGui.MainMenu.MenuController.old_string:
-- (2026-10-28 owner, Index v8 phone "size B": ONE layout on every device) phones: the same Index window, ~88 % of the
	-- SCREEN height and below Roblox's top bar (this gui starts under the bar and fitScale keeps 6 px clear); the 58 % width
	-- cap would shrink it to ~80 %, so the Index gets a 92 % cap there
	local widthCap
	if name == "Index" and B.viewportSize().Y < 520 then
		local gy = gui.AbsoluteSize.Y
		if gy > 0 and size.Y.Scale > 0 then size = mul(size, 0.88 * B.viewportSize().Y / gy / size.Y.Scale) end
		widthCap = 0.92
	end
	size = mul(size, fitScale(size, widthCap))
StarterGui.MainMenu.MenuController.new_string:
-- (2026-10-28 owner, Index v8 phone "size B": ONE layout on every device) phones: the same Index window, as tall as the
	-- screen allows, below Roblox's top bar; the 58 % width cap would shrink it, so the Index gets a 92 % cap there.
	-- (2026-10-29 build review 1 M2) top = 6 px under the top bar, bottom = 18 px above the screen edge: height = screen -
	-- (bar + 6) - 18 (this gui starts under the bar): 308 px with a 58 px bar, 330 px with a 36 px bar
	local widthCap, phoneTop
	if name == "Index" and B.viewportSize().Y < 520 then
		local gy = gui.AbsoluteSize.Y
		if gy > 24 and size.Y.Scale > 0 then size = mul(size, (gy - 24) / gy / size.Y.Scale) end
		widthCap = 0.92
		phoneTop = 6
	end
	size = mul(size, fitScale(size, widthCap))
	if phoneTop then win.Position = UDim2.new(basePos.X.Scale, basePos.X.Offset, 0, phoneTop + size.Y.Scale * gui.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2) end
